name: A MAZE. / Berlin 2026
description: The 15th edition of Berlin's international Games and Playful Media Festival brings together the worldwide independent games community, arthouse game developers, artistic world-builders, digital artists and playful media creators. Taking place across Silent Green, Panke Club and HAU3, the festival celebrates the convergence of games, art and other media with exhibitions, performances, workshops, and the A MAZE. Awards premiering innovative games and playful media.
